bounded.claim: Every PROVEN statement above is bounded to the audited fixtures, profiles, toolchains and declared policies.
The Phase-4 end-to-end claim is bounded to the original fixture, its translation profile and the declared one-tick-per-retired-instruction policy.
The Phase-3 CoreMark real-ELF proof remains the separate bounded Phase-3 claim (tag openrecomp-phase3-pass).

limitations.impact: Structural function ownership excludes orphan delay-slot blocks in the neutral model.
limitations.limitation: The shared Phase-2 structural layers have no delay-slot concept; delay slots are modelled as NORMAL instructions with the relationship recorded separately (inherited Phase-3 limitation, unchanged).

limitations.impact: No claim about arbitrary MIPS32 programs.
limitations.limitation: The Phase-4 fixture deliberately avoids indirect control flow and unaligned accesses to stay inside the proven bounded frontier.

limitations.impact: Other guests require their own generated support subject to the same contracts.
limitations.limitation: The native runtime support is the concrete adapter implementation for this fixture, not a universal runtime.

limitations.impact: A different policy changes the tick transcript fields.
limitations.limitation: Tick values depend on the declared one-tick-per-retired-instruction policy.
External toolchains (zig 0.13.0, LLVM/clang-cl 22.1.8) are pinned by identity and not shipped in the package.

limitations.impact: The package is a snapshot, not a self-contained toolchain.
limitations.limitation: Package bytes are reproducible from the same tree state only, and host-specific command records are excluded by design.

limitations.impact: Policy scans apply fully to all product members only.
limitations.limitation: Gate sources embed the content-policy detection needles and are exempt from needle scans (still UTF-8/LF checked and hashed).

limitations.impact: No CoreMark support claim is implied by Phase 4.
limitations.limitation: CoreMark remains an unsupported target; COREMARK_STATUS=NOT_PROVEN.

not_tested: big-endian MIPS or other architectures through the Phase-4 layers

proven.claim: Phase-4 boundary descends from the frozen Phase-3 PASS boundary and the frozen P3-99 final gate re-runs byte-identically in the reconstructed Phase-3 context.

Architecture-neutral generated-code <-> runtime ABI V1 (state, calls, exits, faults, memory boundary, typed versioned services, deterministic observable) is defined and verified, including compliance of the frozen Phase-3 generated artifacts.
Explicit guest memory model with regions, permissions, bounds, alignment and endian semantics and fail-closed faults mapped to the ABI codes.

Runtime service mediation with typed/versioned interfaces and declared aliases; fixture-specific handling becomes data; unknown services and failures fail closed; the exact frozen external interaction replays byte-identically.
Bounded deterministic I/O, virtual time and input/event delivery with explicit recorded inputs and no ambient host input capability.
Architecture-neutral platform-adapter contract restricted to the generic interface catalog with explicit negative compatibility claims and optional graphics/audio hooks.
Reusable graphics/audio adapter boundaries with capability validation, deterministic headless reference implementations and no mandatory backend.
Original Apache-2.0 interactive fixture is reproducible and its complete decode frontier is inventoried with no indirect or unresolved control flow.

The fixture translates, builds reproducibly and executes natively through a real platform adapter/runtime implementation, reproducing the expected transcript and state digest with fail-closed negatives.
The nine-stage generic-runtime pipeline is demonstrated end-to-end and the observable is verified against an independent reference (own loader, decoder, executor) on every compared field.
A deterministic byte-reproducible package with a verified member manifest and fail-closed content policy.
The complete Phase-1/Phase-2/Phase-3/Phase-4 regression set re-runs from the audited tree with byte-identical stdout and the frozen earlier boundaries remain valid.

unproven: runtime equivalence beyond the audited deterministic observable
unsupported: indirect control flow without a declared resolution mechanism in the shared layers (the reference fails closed; the fixture avoids it)
unaligned multi-byte loads/stores in the emitted/reference paths (fail closed)
instructions outside the audited fixture set in the independent reference (fail closed)
host wall clock, real filesystem, network and process capabilities (no ambient capability path exists)
platform-specific runtime service interface names in V1 (adapters use generic-catalog aliases)
compiled/guest binaries inside the reproducible package (rebuilt from pinned source instead)
